channel.title: Cold Start
channel.description: A software-craft blog about distributed systems, storage engines, and the quiet engineering that keeps production alive.

item.title: The Cost of an fsync, Measured
item.author: mara@coldstart.dev (Mara Quintero)
item.description: Everyone says fsync is expensive. Few say how expensive, or why the number swings by four orders of magnitude depending on your hardware. A short, numbers-first field note.

item.title: Consensus Without Tears: What Raft Actually Promises
item.author: mara@coldstart.dev (Mara Quintero)
item.description: Distributed consensus has a reputation for being impossibly hard. Raft made it merely difficult. Here's the mental model that makes Raft click.

item.title: Backpressure, or How to Say No Before You Fall Over
item.author: devin@coldstart.dev (Devin Osei)
item.description: Unbounded queues are not resilience — they're a slow-motion outage with extra latency. A practical look at backpressure, load shedding, and the art of failing on purpose.

item.title: Idempotency Keys: The Cheapest Insurance in Distributed Systems
item.author: mara@coldstart.dev (Mara Quintero)
item.description: A small, boring pattern that quietly prevents double-charges, duplicate orders, and a whole category of 2 a.m. pages.

item.title: Your Retries Are Making the Outage Worse
item.author: devin@coldstart.dev (Devin Osei)
item.description: Retries feel like resilience. Under load they're often the thing that turns a small hiccup into a full outage.

item.title: LSM Trees vs. B-Trees: A Bet About Your Workload
item.author: mara@coldstart.dev (Mara Quintero)
item.description: B-trees and LSM trees aren't competitors so much as opposite wagers on whether you read more than you write.

item.title: The Write-Ahead Log Is the Database
item.author: mara@coldstart.dev (Mara Quintero)
item.description: Almost every durable storage system you use is, underneath, a write-ahead log with some indexes bolted on top.
